recognize_zh: CD61 免疫染色中骨小樑之間充滿強陽性的細胞，包括大小不一的巨核細胞與許多小型陽性細胞（megakaryoblasts），並呈流線狀排列於纖維化基質中，支持唐氏症相關骨髓性白血病的巨核芽細胞分化。
features: Strong cytoplasmic/membranous CD61 staining in numerous megakaryocytic cells between bony trabeculae
Positive cells range from large megakaryocytes to small mononuclear cells, indicating megakaryoblasts and micromegakaryocytes
Clustered and sheet-like distribution with streaming of positive cells, suggesting fibrotic stroma
Hematoxylin counterstain shows spindled negative stromal cells and bone trabeculae (blue-gray)
describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights an extensive proliferation of megakaryocytic cells occupying the intertrabecular spaces. The positive cells range from small mononuclear forms consistent with megakaryoblasts and micromegakaryocytes to larger megakaryocytes, arranged in clusters and streaming sheets within a spindle-cell, fibrotic-appearing stroma. In the clinical context of Down syndrome with prior transient abnormal myelopoiesis, findings support myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome with megakaryoblastic differentiation.

ddx.vs: CD61 in MPN marks mainly large mature megakaryocytes, without the many small CD61-positive blasts seen here, and occurs in adults lacking GATA1 mutation.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Metastatic neuroblastoma or rhabdomyosarcoma cells are CD61 negative and express their own lineage markers (e.g. PHOX2B, myogenin).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with other lineage differentiation and fibrosis
ddx.vs: Non-megakaryoblastic AML blasts are CD61 negative and instead express MPO, CD117 or monocytic markers.
